create_modifier: create a modifier instance by type name with keyword arguments and registry flags
register_modifier: register a custom modifier class with the factory by type name for later instantiation
refresh_modifiers: refresh the factory by reloading all modifier classes from the main and experimental packages
load_from_package: load modifier classes from a given package path and return a mapping of name to class
review_modifier_factory: review the ModifierFactory class and its registry-based modifier instantiation pattern
